en-US.longDescription: LinkEase is a software that supports data management across multiple devices, featuring backing up photos from mobile phones to other devices, transferring files between devices, and data backup and synchronization across devices.

zh-CN.longDescription: 易有云是一款支持多设备之间数据管理的软件，支持手机相片备份到其他设备上，设备之间的文件互传，设备之间的数据备份和同步等。
zh-CN.name: LinkEase
zh-CN.publisher: 深圳市易有云网络科技有限责任公司
